turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why did you give my son a zero without calling me first?
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.
Frazzled isn't an answer. Who decided on the zero, and was it before anyone spoke to Owen?
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
I'm not here to be thanked. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
Kind was a phone call before the gradebook. What evidence do you have on the essay?
